{{Quote|The creatures that attacked your Senator Dodonna are a Gormak abomination.|[[Lokir-Ka]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''ssorokk''', alternatively known as a '''cyberbeast''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], and referred to as "'''a-boms'''" by the [[Exchange]], was the term applied to a creature that had been cybernetically altered by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] to serve as a war beast. Citizens of [[Voss]] considered these cyborg creatures to be ''abominations''.

==History==
The [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]]'s fascination with technology has led them to experiment heavily in the field of organic-cybernetic hybrids, using the native fauna of [[Voss]] as their test subjects. Gormak hunting parties regularly set out to trap [[Crysfang|crysfangs]], [[Shaclaw|shaclaws]] and even the [[vorantikus]] alive so that the creatures can be implanted with cybernetic upgrades, advancing their aggressive capabilities and characteristics such as speed and strength.<ref name="codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Cyberbeasts}}</ref>

While the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] considered this practice barbaric, [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] themselves believed that their work improves the creatures in ways the nature intended. The cybernetic implants allowed the Gormak to influence the natural instincts of the beasts, effectively programming them with simple yet very specific instructions. In the [[Gormak Lands|Gormak lands]], cyberbeasts were often used as guardians.<ref name="codex" />

[[Mug'garat]] brought two of the creatures to accost [[Bevera Dodonna]] and the smuggler [[Voidhound]] on behalf of [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]]. Senator Dodonna was traumatized by the encounter and sent the Voidhound to root out the source of the beasts on Voss. [[Gormak Zak]] obtained the creatures from the Gormak and sold to off-world buyers with the help of his partner [[Jela Reneke]], who smuggled them out in defiance of the proscription on their trade by [[Voss]] authorities. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Wratchen]] encouraged Reneke to expand the Gormak cybernetics program to focus on creatures living in the [[Nightmare Lands]]. The Voidhound killed two of these creatures along with Wratchen and Reneke, ending the program.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as [[Hunter (individual)|Scree]] defeated three of the beasts in the gladiatorial arena of [[Gorma-Koss]].
